notes.title: I hereby announce INFESTED GROUNDS
notes.notes:
[b]Infested Grounds[/b] is a first-person survival-horror game where you [b]Explore[/b] an apocalyptic open world, [b]Survive[/b] brutal attacks by using zombies as fodder, [b]Upgrade[/b] your weapons with exotic materials, and [b]Fight[/b] the monstrosities that haunt you.
